Item.Name: INTER_ON_OTHER_PRODS
Item.Hint: Enter valid Product Codes separated by commas

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t_comma_pos number;
 t_prod_code varchar2(100);
 t_other_prods varchar2(100);
 t_dummy varchar2(1);
 v_sysdate date;
begin
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED') then
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prods := replace(rtrim(ltrim(:valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prods)), ' ', '');
 if :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prods is not null then
 t_other_prods := :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prods;
 loop
 t_comma_pos := instr(t_other_prods, ',', 1);
 t_prod_code := null;
 if t_comma_pos = 0 then
 t_prod_code := t_other_prods;
 t_other_prods := null;
 else
 begin
 select substr(t_other_prods, 1, instr(t_other_prods, ',', 1) - 1)
 into t_prod_code
 from dual;
 end;
 t_other_prods := replace(t_other_prods, t_prod_code || ',', '');
 end if;
 
 begin
 select 'x'
 into t_dummy
 from valid_products
 where v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365)
 and upper(product_code) = t_prod_code; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 exit when nvl(length(t_other_prods), 0) <= 0;
 end loop;
 end if; -- if :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prods is not null then
 end if; -- if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'CHANGED') then
end;

 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED') then

 :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prod_types := replace(rtrim(ltrim(:valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prod_types)), ' ', '');
 if :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prod_types is not null then
 t_other_prods := :valid_auto_inter_config.inter_on_other_prod_types;
 loop
 t_comma_pos := instr(t_other_prods, ',', 1);
 t_prod_type := null;
 if t_comma_pos = 0 then
 t_prod_type := t_other_prods;
 t_other_prods := null;
 else

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
-- Added by Kishore on 02/01/2012. IM 6394
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('3141');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;
-- End of change
